description: Curated from the completed local research workspace. Certificate and saved report bytes are unchanged; large JSON inputs use lossless gzip. Documentation and code copies have relocated paths; original workspace is unchanged. Release 1.1.0 (2026-10-21) added the rank-four follow-up work (level-four zero, Eisenstein family, parity property, independent assessment) under the same conventions; large preserved reports are gzip files listed in reports/compressed-reports.json. Release 1.2.0 (2026-10-21) added the determinant census through 279 (minimum counterexample determinant 280) under the same conventions; its per-determinant chunks are gzip files read compressed by code/rank4_gap_census.py and are not listed in reports/compressed-reports.json. Release 1.3.0 (2026-10-21) added the work on even lattices of odd determinant (minus-type report, stage-two reductions and their review, the plus-type class list) under the same conventions; the plus-type per-determinant chunks and the minus-type class list are gzip files read compressed and are not listed in reports/compressed-reports.json.
